How Live Sync works
  1. In the configurator, copy ID to plugin and press Sync now (required — editing on localhost does not publish)
  2. Paste ID to plugin, then press Start sync
  3. Re-publish on the web → this file updates on its own
  4. No login needed — the endpoint is public and read-only. Tokens living in a Git repo aren't covered: download tokens.json and use Import instead.
